liz (product): Quick async spot-check — pricing change target = Wed EOD. Need one-line owner/status for: metering integration, billing schema, quota enforcement, contract exceptions. Please ping if anything blocks. :eyes:

sam (eng): Metering side: PR #451 opened (ingest + exporter). Tests passing locally. Waiting on infra review for the batching switch. ETA Tue EOD. Example event we emit: `{"customer_id":"cust_123","product":"api","tokens":456}`

ravi (billing): Billing integration: blocked on invoice schema v2 (contracts reference legacy min-billable-unit). Filed billing issue #789 with examples. Need legal sign-off for grandfathered customers — that could change charge rounding. If legal can't sign off, we need a temporary adapter in billing to emulate old rounding.

dana (infra): I can review sam's PR tomorrow AM. One infra note: we need a canary plan before full rollout — suggest canary = 5% traffic for 24h with auto-rollback on error rate > 1% or increased latency +20%. I'll add canary job to the deploy pipeline.

anya (sre): Quotas enforcement: ratelimit-service can map tiers -> quota buckets but I need the definitive mapping. @liz can you confirm platinum/gold/silver/default token quotas? Also any exceptions for enterprise (soft-limits) should be listed.

liz (product): Link to current tier mapping: https://drive.redwood/pkgs/pricing_tiers.xlsx — note: enterprise customers A & B are grandfathered with soft limits (no hard cutoff; warn + invoice). I'll update the spreadsheet with contract IDs by EOD.

ravi (billing): Thanks — once that's in, I can update invoice schema and run a dry-run against last-month usage. If dry-run diff < 0.5% we're OK. Otherwise we need adapter.

sam (eng): Adding checklist items to PR description: 1) infra review, 2) ratelimit mapping, 3) billing dry-run, 4) contract exceptions documented. Also tagging @dana @ravi in the PR for approvals.

metering-bot: metering-e2e: started -> running tests (CI job 5123)

metering-bot: metering-e2e: finished -> 1 flaky test failed (token-aggregation); opened flake issue #5124

dana (infra): Flaky test noted. If it's aggregation edge-case, we should still canary but with tighter monitoring on token-count deltas for the first 4 hours.

liz (product): Sounds good. I'll consolidate these into the cross-team checklist and post to the release thread. If anything else blocks immediate review, reply here. :thumbsup:
